title: Any idea for side scrolling art games?
author: renjiaaa
selftext:
Hello,

I am making this ddtank inspired single player game. However, would like to get your help in recommending what to use for art? I've been drilling down the details on getting the art that it feels right. I've been giving it reference to the ddtank weapon, and personally i have been drilling down some details per weapon. But it feels weird that it doesnt feel right.

I've tried using pixel stuff, but it doesn't feel right.

So, would like to ask for any recommendations for the art tools you guys use for a side scrolling game that isnt pixel?
